goal: Read docs/IDEA.md with no history and write docs/BRIEF.md: what this round asks for.

acceptance_criteria.text: docs/BRIEF.md has the sections Asked, Deliverable, Done when, Unclear and Not asked

decisions.what: Treat the round as a change to the existing project, not a new build
decisions.why: The idea lists targeted edits and says to keep everything earlier rounds built and the branding
decisions.evidence: docs/IDEA.md L12: "Keep everything the earlier rounds built and the business's branding; change only what these suggestions ask."

decisions.what: List pyarrow only as a dependency, with no code use
decisions.why: The idea requires it in requirements.txt but names no change that uses it

decisions.what: Put the unexplained references (G-1..G-7, AC-6/AC-13 new wording, test_G_* new names, which tables) under Unclear
decisions.why: The idea names them but gives no definitions or target wording, and filling the gaps would be guessing
